# narration link

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:narrationLink`](gmeow-narrationLink.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/narrationLink>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

The abstract ancestor of the narration seam — any link between carrying text (an [`InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md) side: segment, document, panel) and diegetic content (an entity, event, or situation in the story). Never asserted directly: use [`gmeow:narrates`](gmeow-narrates.md) (segment → content) or [`gmeow:narratedIn`](gmeow-narratedIn.md) (content → segment). Domain- and range-free at this level so media-specific seams (panel, shot, verse) can specialize without re-plumbing.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:narrationLink`](gmeow-narrationLink.md) when the definition matches the source fact. Prefer a narrower GMEOW term when one exists, and keep projection concerns in the mapping layer.
